title: floor refs and census paths come back with forward slashes on every box
intention: Every path the orient floor and census emit is written with forward slashes, so a ref resolves and compares the same on every box.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: orient.py:95 and :252 emit str(Path.relative_to(...)); the orchestrator reports backslash refs on akiendell
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a ref that differs by box defeats the door's re-run of the floor (provenance falls to 'claude'); CP4.
how: Emit as_posix() at the emitting sites in orient.py; the red-first proof checks the emitted strings carry no backslash.

clauses.claim: no path string emitted by the orient floor or census contains a backslash
the same strings still resolve to the files they name

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: orient.py:95 and :252 emit str(Path.relative_to(...)); the orchestrator reports backslash refs on akiendell
measured.how: git grep -n relative_to over orient.py (the on-box refs are not re-captured: HYPOTHESIS that these two sites are the whole cause)

measured.saw: After the build (89973002c): call_sites('write_trace') had 103 backslash paths before, 0 after; device_census dirs resolve under cairn/. grep of relative_to( across cairn/tools/orient finds only the two fixed sites. NOT measured: whether the orchestrator's reported backslash refs come from these two sites; chart_gate/ has no str(Path)/os.path emitters by grep, but the gate's floor (packet_of) was not run end-to-end and refs emitted elsewhere (e.g. other floors) are unexamined. 'These two sites are the whole cause' therefore stays a HYPOTHESIS for PROVEME to judge.
measured.how: proof test_orient_emits_forward_slash_paths.py run twice (2/2 teeth green; 1/2 red before the fix); Grep relative_to over cairn/tools/orient; Grep for path-string emitters in chart_gate
